context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend refactoring complete and tested. All routes in /app/backend/routes/ working correctly. AuthContext fix applied - login response parsing now correctly extracts email and name from top-level response (not nested under 'user'). Key test card: 820551-447-797 (Jorge Tou's stamp card). Demo cards (DEMO-*) use mock data.

bug_fixed.issue: Frontend login not navigating after successful authentication
bug_fixed.root_cause: AuthContext.js was expecting login response to have nested 'user' object, but API returns email/name at top level
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Updated login() and register() functions in AuthContext.js to correctly parse response.data.email and response.data.name instead of response.data.user

mocked_api_note: DEMO-* cards use MOCK data for demo purposes. Real card 820551-447-797 uses live Boomerangme API.
